title: Study of Cross-Cutting E-Health Prevention Approaches
official: A Pilot Study of Cross-Cutting E-Health Prevention Approaches to Address Campus Sexual Assault and Alcohol Misuse.
summary: The National Institute of Health Academic Research Enhancement Award research study fills a major gap in sexual violence and alcohol misuse prevention on college campuses by implementing and testing the feasibility of a multi-level social ecological model approach consisting of six established e-health primary prevention strategies in a feasibility study.

interventions.name: Cross Cutting e-health Prevention Program Individual Interventions

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* full-time University of New Hampshire student
* first-year University of New Hampshire student
* live in the University of New Hampshire residence halls
* not married

Exclusion Criteria:

* not a University of New Hampshire first-year student
* does not live in the University of New Hampshire residence halls
* married
